_comment: Clarity in the Quran (@ClarityInTheQuran, UC0eBu0ZXcF20pTAG3lUnPXA) packaging fix, 2026-08-17. Built from clarity/channel-diagnosis.md. Applied by automation/clarity_packaging.py.
_expect_channel_id: Enforced before any write: the script resolves the authenticated channel with mine=true and aborts unless it equals this. Three channels share this repo and one wrong token silently repackages the wrong one.
_tags_provenance: IMPORTANT — these tags were WRITTEN, not harvested. The diagnosis first claimed the 'RELATED SEARCHES' paragraph in each description could simply be moved into the tags field. Testing that on the real descriptions disproved it: those paragraphs are flowing prose, so a mechanical extract yields fragments like 'this video was made for you', 'this study goes deep into all of it' and 'or is it allowed to be rich in Islam', and QNlRJcyY4LU yields nothing at all. Bad tags are worse than none — they spend the 500-char field on noise. Each list below is hand-written from the video's actual subject, using the harvested phrases only as raw material.
_tag_budget: YouTube caps the entire tags field at 500 characters and rejects the whole update with `invalidTags` past it. A tag containing a space is sent quoted, costing two extra characters. clarity_packaging.py budgets 460 and drops overflow rather than failing the write.

description_edits._why: The credibility repair, and the single highest-priority item in the diagnosis. This line is Christian-sermon register sitting in a Quran channel's best-performing video, where a viewer already commented 'AI BE AWARE'. Removing the line is a strict deletion — nothing is added, reworded or reordered, so the rest of a genuinely good description is untouched.
description_edits.remove_line: ▸ The cross is not the answer here — the mercy of Allah and the example of the Prophet ﷺ is

channel._why: youtube_channel_about returned keywords: [] — the channel has no channel-level keywords at all. Weak signal alone, but it is one of the few inputs YouTube uses to place a channel in a topic cluster, and empty gives it nothing. Costs nothing, cannibalises nothing. Same free win taken on channel 2.

protected._why: Never repackage a proven winner. These four carry 1,452 of the channel's 2,473 lifetime views. Their TITLES and DESCRIPTION BODIES must not move — retitling a settled video measured +0 views over 21.7 hours on channel 1, and that finding is about how YouTube treats settled videos rather than about any channel's subject. Adding tags to them is safe and additive; the one description edit above is a defect repair on a specific line, not a rewrite.

deferred._why: Named here so they are not silently dropped. Each needs a human decision or content this repo does not have.
